# KeyBadge

A musical key as a Camelot-coloured dot plus the code in mono ("● 8A"), with the key name ("A minor") in detail views and tooltips.

`SongNodes.KeyBadge` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.KeyBadge value={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.KeyBadge" value="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (KeyBadgeProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `string \| null \| undefined` | Any key notation ("8A", "Am", "A minor"); normalised with SongNodes.camelot(). |
| `withName` | `boolean` | Show the key name next to the code (detail views). |
| `size` | `"row" \| "lg"` | "row" (default) or "lg" for detail headers. |
